content: CRITICAL iOS quirk: HTMLMediaElement.volume is NOT settable on iOS devices - Apple docs: 'volume property is not settable in JavaScript; reading always returns 1'. iOS 13.3+ may appear to set then revert to 1 after event loop. muted (boolean) works reliably on iOS. Android WebView (Chromium) honors volume 0-1 normally. MDN marks volume as not-Baseline 'does not work in some widely-used browsers'. Workaround used by Livekit/Zoom: AudioContext gainNode, but that breaks video element audio graph and autoplay; better: feature-detect volume, fall back to muted-only on iOS.
